verdict.rationale: skills.sh supports all three distribution paths in the story. Skills install by default at project scope into `./<agent>/skills/`, which the docs describe as "Committed with your project, shared with team." The same `skills add` command works with public and private GitHub, GitLab and Azure Repos using existing auth. Teammates can restore a shared set from `skills-lock.json` and install non-interactively in CI, and the public leaderboard acts as a discovery marketplace. A runtime probe confirms the CLI runs keylessly and can list a repo's skills before installing. Missing for 10: the lockfile restore path is partly labeled experimental, and there is no independent hands-on report of rolling out a standard skill set across a team.
